```python
    add_parser.add_argument("--desc", required=True, help="Description")

    # List command
    list_parser = subparsers.add_parser("list", help="List expenses with filters")
    list_parser.add_argument("--date", type=validate_date)
    list_parser.add_argument("--category")
    list_parser.add_argument("--min", type=float, help="Minimum amount")
    list_parser.add_argument("--max", type=float, help="Maximum amount")

    # Summary command
    summary_parser = subparsers.add_parser("summary", help="Show spending summary")
    summary_parser.add_argument("--by", choices=["category", "date"], default="category")
    summary_parser.add_argument("--from", help="Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    summary_parser.add_argument("--to", help="End date (YYYY-MM-DD)")

    # Export command
    export_parser = subparsers.add_parser("export", help="Export data to CSV")
    export_parser.add_argument("--format", choices=["csv"], required=True)

    args = parser.parse_args()

    expenses = load_expenses()

    if args.command == "add":
        add_expense(args.date.isoformat(), args.category, args.amount, args.desc)

    elif args.command == "list":
        filtered = filter_expenses(
            expenses,
            date=args.date.isoformat() if args.date else None,
            category=args.category,
            min_amount=args.min,
            max_amount=args.max
        )
        for e in filtered:
            print(f"{e['date']} | {e['category']} | ${e['amount']:.2f} | {e['description']}")

    elif args.command == "summary":
        generate_summary(expenses, by=args.by, start=args.from, end=args.to)

    elif args.command == "export":
        export_csv(expenses)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
